title: Exporting Variables for the Session
description: export keeps a variable set for every command in the terminal session, and unset removes it.

steps.description: The page says that to keep a flag active for every command in your terminal session, you use `export`. `export DEBUG=1` sets `DEBUG` for the whole session.
Both runs see `DEBUG`. The comments note that the variable is set for the first command and still set for the second.
`unset DEBUG` removes the variable when you are done.

steps.question: The page says `export` keeps a flag active for every command in the session. Which command removes it when you are done?
